rulesClauses: Look at the top six cards of your deck. You may reveal a Potion item card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. BrewingKitPotionPick was queued without dontSkipOnPass, so declining the Potion (MZMAYCHOOSE answered PASS) made ExecuteStaticMethods() skip the handler and BrewingKitCleanup never ran: all six looked-at cards stayed in the temp zone and the deck was six cards short (live repro on HEAD: deck 14 instead of 20). Fix: dontSkipOnPass:1 at the queue site.
